-- ============================================================
-- paneer's Menu — WindUI
-- Todos los exploits confirmados integrados
-- ============================================================

-- Cargar WindUI
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

-- Servicios
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local RS = ReplicatedStorage

-- Packet library del juego
local Packets = require(RS.Utils.Packets)

-- Estado global
local state = {
    m1Auto = false,
    abilitySpam = false,
    dashSpam = false,
    blockSpam = false,
    wheelSpinSpam = false,
    confettiSpam = false,
    rainbowPortal = false,
    espEnabled = false,
    fovEnabled = false,
    zoomEnabled = false,
}

local espObjects = {}
local requestId = 0

-- ============================================================
-- FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
-- ============================================================

local function getChar()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char, char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getClosestEnemy(range)
    range = range or 12
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end
    local closest, minDist = nil, range
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            local php = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local phum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if php and phum and phum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (php.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist then
                    closest, minDist = php, dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function hsvToHex(h, s, v)
    return "#" .. Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v):ToHex()
end

-- ============================================================
-- CREAR VENTANA
-- ============================================================

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "paneer's Hub",
    Icon = "crown",
    Author = "by paneer",
    Folder = "paneersHub",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 420),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = "Dark",
    Resizable = true,
    SideBarWidth = 180,
    HideSearchBar = true,
    ScrollBarEnabled = false,
})

-- Tabs
local MainTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Principal", Icon = "home" })
local CombatTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Combate", Icon = "sword" })
local ExploitsTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Exploits", Icon = "zap" })
local VisualsTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Visuales", Icon = "eye" })
local RewardsTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Recompensas", Icon = "gift" })

-- ============================================================
-- TAB PRINCIPAL
-- ============================================================

local mainSection = MainTab:Section({ Title = "Estado", Opened = true })

mainSection:Button({
    Title = "Ver Morteys",
    Desc = "Busca el contador en la GUI",
    Callback = function()
        local PlayerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local found = false
        local function scan(inst, path, depth)
            if depth > 10 then return end
            path = path or ""
            if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") then
                local txt = inst.Text
                if txt and txt:match("^[%d,]+$") and #txt >= 3 then
                    print("[paneer] NUMERO: " .. path .. "." .. inst.Name .. " = " .. txt)
                    found = true
                end
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
                scan(c, path .. "." .. inst.Name, depth + 1)
            end
        end
        scan(PlayerGui, "PlayerGui", 0)
        if not found then
            print("[paneer] No se encontraron números grandes en la GUI")
        end
    end,
})

mainSection:Button({
    Title = "Ver Inventario",
    Desc = "Muestra habilidades y gun models poseídos",
    Callback = function()
        for _, folderName in ipairs({"OwnedSpecials", "OwnedUltimates", "OwnedGunModels"}) do
            local folder = LP:FindFirstChild(folderName)
            if folder then
                print("[paneer] === " .. folderName .. " ===")
                for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value then
                        print("  ✓ " .. v.Name)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- TAB COMBATE
-- ============================================================

local combatSection = CombatTab:Section({ Title = "Auto M1", Opened = true })

combatSection:Toggle({
    Title = "M1 Auto + Aim",
    Desc = "Ataca automáticamente y se gira al enemigo más cercano",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.m1Auto = v
    end,
})

combatSection:Slider({
    Title = "Rango de Aim",
    Desc = "Distancia para apuntar",
    Step = 1,
    Value = { Min = 5, Max = 50, Default = 12 },
    Callback = function(v)
        state.m1Range = v
    end,
})

local abilitySection = CombatTab:Section({ Title = "Habilidades", Opened = true })

abilitySection:Toggle({
    Title = "Spam de Habilidades",
    Desc = "Activa Special y Ultimate continuamente",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.abilitySpam = v
    end,
})

local dashSection = CombatTab:Section({ Title = "Dash y Block", Opened = true })

dashSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Spam de Dash",
    Desc = "Dash front continuo",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.dashSpam = v
    end,
})

dashSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Spam de Block",
    Desc = "Toggle rápido de bloqueo",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.blockSpam = v
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- TAB EXPLOITS
-- ============================================================

local packetSection = ExploitsTab:Section({ Title = "Packets", Opened = true })

packetSection:Toggle({
    Title = "WheelSpin Infinito",
    Desc = "Gira la ruleta sin límite — CONFIRMADO",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.wheelSpinSpam = v
    end,
})

packetSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Confetti a Todos",
    Desc = "Emite confetti global — CONFIRMADO",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.confettiSpam = v
    end,
})

packetSection:Button({
    Title = "Disparar Confetti (una vez)",
    Desc = "Emite confetti inmediatamente",
    Callback = function()
        pcall(function() Packets.Conffeti.Emit:Fire() end)
    end,
})

local portalSection = ExploitsTab:Section({ Title = "Portal", Opened = true })

portalSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Portal Arcoíris",
    Desc = "Cambia el color del portal en ciclo HSV",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.rainbowPortal = v
    end,
})

portalSection:Slider({
    Title = "Velocidad Arcoíris",
    Desc = "Segundos por tick (más bajo = más rápido)",
    Step = 0.01,
    Value = { Min = 0.03, Max = 0.5, Default = 0.08 },
    Callback = function(v)
        state.rainbowSpeed = v
    end,
})

portalSection:Button({
    Title = "Equipar Portal",
    Desc = "Fuerza la creación de un portal",
    Callback = function()
        local PortalSlotAction = RS.Functions:FindFirstChild("PortalSlotAction")
        if PortalSlotAction then
            pcall(function() PortalSlotAction:InvokeServer("Equip") end)
        end
    end,
})

local codeSection = ExploitsTab:Section({ Title = "Códigos", Opened = false })

codeSection:Button({
    Title = "Probar Códigos Comunes",
    Desc = "Prueba una wordlist de códigos potenciales",
    Callback = function()
        local codes = {"FREE", "MORTY", "RICK", "PORTAL", "SUMMER", "BETH", "JERRY",
                       "EVILMORTY", "PRIME", "C137", "BIRD", "PICKLE", "TINY"}
        for _, code in ipairs(codes) do
            pcall(function()
                local a, b = Packets.Codes.RedeemCode:Fire(code)
                if type(a) == "table" then
                    print("[paneer] Code " .. code .. " -> " .. tostring(a[1]) .. " | " .. tostring(a[2]))
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.8)
        end
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- TAB VISUALES
-- ============================================================

local espSection = VisualsTab:Section({ Title = "ESP", Opened = true })

espSection:Toggle({
    Title = "ESP de Jugadores",
    Desc = "Cajas y nombres sobre enemigos",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.espEnabled = v
        if not v then
            for _, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
                objs.box:Remove()
                objs.name:Remove()
            end
            espObjects = {}
        end
    end,
})

local fovSection = VisualsTab:Section({ Title = "Cámara", Opened = true })

fovSection:Toggle({
    Title = "FOV Hack",
    Desc = "Forza el FieldOfView localmente (client-side)",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.fovEnabled = v
    end,
})

fovSection:Slider({
    Title = "FOV",
    Desc = "Valor del FieldOfView",
    Step = 1,
    Value = { Min = 70, Max = 140, Default = 120 },
    Callback = function(v)
        state.fovValue = v
    end,
})

fovSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Zoom Extendido",
    Desc = "MaxZoomDistance = 1000",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        state.zoomEnabled = v
        if v then
            LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000
        end
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- TAB RECOMPENSAS
-- ============================================================

local rewardSection = RewardsTab:Section({ Title = "Recompensas", Opened = true })

rewardSection:Button({
    Title = "Reclamar Todo (Playtime + Daily)",
    Desc = "Envía los packets de todas las recompensas",
    Callback = function()
        for i = 1, 7 do
            pcall(function() Packets.PlaytimeRewards.ClaimReward:Fire(i) end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
        for i = 1, 7 do
            pcall(function() Packets.DailyRewards.ClaimReward:Fire(i) end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
        pcall(function() Packets.FriendReward.ClaimReward:Fire() end)
        pcall(function() Packets.GroupReward.ClaimReward:Fire() end)
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Recompensas", Content = "Todos los packets enviados", Duration = 3 })
    end,
})

rewardSection:Button({
    Title = "Verificar Pases",
    Desc = "Muestra si tienes los gamepasses",
    Callback = function()
        local passIds = {
            ["Custom Portal Color"] = 1979288487,
            ["VIP"] = 1853711135,
            ["Teleporter"] = 1853549088,
            ["x2 Speed"] = 1853099131,
        }
        for name, id in pairs(passIds) do
            pcall(function()
                local owned = Packets.Marketplace.CheckPassOwned:Fire(id, name)
                print("[paneer] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(owned))
            end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- LOOPS DE EJECUCIÓN
-- ============================================================

-- M1 Auto + Aim
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.15) do
        if state.m1Auto then
            local char, hum, hrp = getChar()
            if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp then
                local target = getClosestEnemy(state.m1Range or 12)
                if target then
                    local lookPos = Vector3.new(target.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, target.Position.Z)
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, lookPos)
                end
                requestId = requestId + 1
                local CombatEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("CombatEvent")
                if CombatEvent then
                    pcall(function()
                        CombatEvent:FireServer({
                            action = "Start",
                            gunMode = false,
                            requestId = requestId,
                            finisher = nil,
                            predictedStage = 1,
                            rootCFrame = hrp.CFrame,
                            sentAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                        })
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Ability Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.abilitySpam then
            local AbilityAction = RS.Functions:FindFirstChild("AbilityAction")
            if AbilityAction then
                for _, ability in ipairs({"Special", "Ultimate"}) do
                    local ok, res = pcall(function()
                        return AbilityAction:InvokeServer("Activate", ability)
                    end)
                    if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.serial then
                        task.wait(0.3)
                        pcall(function()
                            AbilityAction:InvokeServer("Release", ability, res.serial)
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Dash Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.dashSpam then
            local DashEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("DashEvent")
            if DashEvent then
                requestId = requestId + 1
                pcall(function() DashEvent:FireServer("Start", "Front", requestId) end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Block Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do
        if state.blockSpam then
            local BlockEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("BlockEvent")
            if BlockEvent then
                pcall(function() BlockEvent:FireServer(true) end)
                task.wait(0.05)
                pcall(function() BlockEvent:FireServer(false) end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- WheelSpin Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        if state.wheelSpinSpam then
            pcall(function() Packets.WheelSpin.Spin:Fire() end)
        end
    end
end)

-- Confetti Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.confettiSpam then
            pcall(function() Packets.Conffeti.Emit:Fire() end)
        end
    end
end)

-- Rainbow Portal
task.spawn(function()
    local hue = 0
    while true do
        local speed = state.rainbowSpeed or 0.08
        if state.rainbowPortal then
            hue = (hue + 0.008) % 1
            local hex = hsvToHex(hue, 1, 1)
            pcall(function() Packets.Settings.SavePortalColor:Fire(hex) end)
        end
        task.wait(speed)
    end
end)

-- ESP
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function createESP(player)
    if player == LP or espObjects[player] then return end
    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Thickness = 1; box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); box.Filled = false; box.Visible = false
    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Size = 14; name.Center = true; name.Outline = true
    name.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); name.Visible = false
    espObjects[player] = {box = box, name = name}
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do createESP(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if espObjects[p] then
        espObjects[p].box:Remove(); espObjects[p].name:Remove(); espObjects[p] = nil
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.espEnabled then
        for _, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
            objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end
    for player, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local headPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
                    local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - pos.Y) * 1.8
                    local width = height / 2
                    objs.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    objs.box.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X - width/2, pos.Y - height/2)
                    objs.box.Visible = true
                    objs.name.Text = player.Name .. " [" .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. "]"
                    objs.name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y - height/2 - 20)
                    objs.name.Visible = true
                end
            else
                objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
        end
    end
end)

-- FOV + Zoom
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if state.fovEnabled and cam then
        local targetFOV = state.fovValue or 120
        if cam.FieldOfView ~= targetFOV then
            cam.FieldOfView = targetFOV
        end
    end
    if state.zoomEnabled then
        if LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance ~= 1000 then
            LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000
        end
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- NOTIFICACIÓN
-- ============================================================

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "paneer's Hub",
    Content = "Menú cargado. Todos los exploits activos.",
    Duration = 5,
})

print("[paneer] Menú definitivo cargado")

--[[
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    JOHN DOE ABILITY PROP — MR.XENO  (FINAL)
    Abilities : LASER / SWING / GRAB / BLEACH
    State     : idle → summon → ability → retract → hidden
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

local Players      = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService   = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS          = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui      = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LP         = Players.LocalPlayer
local OWNER_NAME = LP.Name

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- CONFIG
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CONFIG = {
    PROP_PARENT_FOLDER = "WorkspaceCom",
    PROP_LIST_FOLDER   = "001_TrafficCones",
    PROP_PREFIX        = "Prop",
    MAX_PROPS          = 30,
    HIDDEN_FAR         = 200,
    IDLE_ORBIT_RADIUS  = 4.2,
    IDLE_ORBIT_HEIGHT  = 2.2,
    LASER_RANGE        = 45,
    LASER_HEIGHT       = 2.2,
    SWING_RADIUS       = 9,
    GRAB_RANGE         = 60,
    BLEACH_RANGE       = 70,
    CYCLE_SPEED        = 0.55,
    TICK_RATE          = 0.06,
}

local ABILITY_DEFS = {
    LASER  = { cooldown = 4.0 },
    SWING  = { cooldown = 3.5 },
    GRAB   = { cooldown = 5.0 },
    BLEACH = { cooldown = 8.0 },
}
local ABILITY_ORDER = { "LASER", "SWING", "GRAB", "BLEACH" }

local COLOR_PRESETS = {
    { name = "CORRUPTED", palette = {
        Color3.fromRGB(255,  60,  60),
        Color3.fromRGB(180,  20,  30),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 140),
        Color3.fromRGB( 60,   5,  10),
    }},
    { name = "BLOOD", palette = {
        Color3.fromRGB(180,  10,  15),
        Color3.fromRGB(120,   5,  10),
        Color3.fromRGB(220,  30,  40),
        Color3.fromRGB( 40,   0,   0),
    }},
    { name = "PHOENIX", palette = {
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 100,  30),
        Color3.fromRGB(255,  40,  10),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100),
        Color3.fromRGB( 80,  10,   0),
    }},
}

local THEME = {
    bg        = Color3.fromRGB(12,  8, 10),
    panel     = Color3.fromRGB(18, 10, 12),
    button    = Color3.fromRGB(26, 14, 16),
    buttonHov = Color3.fromRGB(40, 18, 20),
    red       = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 50),
    redBright = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 80),
    redGlow   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 145),
    redDark   = Color3.fromRGB(90, 15, 20),
    text      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 225, 225),
    textDim   = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 125),
    stroke    = Color3.fromRGB(70, 18, 22),
}

local state = {
    enabled=false, showIdle=false, adjusting=false, minimized=false,
    colorIndex=1, color=Color3.fromRGB(220,40,50), colorPhase=0,
    currentAbility=nil,
    abilityState = { LASER="idle", SWING="idle", GRAB="idle", BLEACH="idle" },
    lastUsed     = { LASER=-math.huge, SWING=-math.huge, GRAB=-math.huge, BLEACH=-math.huge },
    props={}, currentCFrames={}, originalColors={}, tickAccum=0,
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- PROP HELPERS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function getRoot()
    local char = LP.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getPropFolder()
    local parent = workspace:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.PROP_PARENT_FOLDER)
    return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.PROP_LIST_FOLDER)
end

local function rememberProp(prop)
    if not prop then return end
    if prop:IsA("BasePart") and not state.originalColors[prop] then
        state.originalColors[prop] = prop.Color
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(prop:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and not state.originalColors[d] then
            state.originalColors[d] = d.Color
        end
    end
end

local function scanProps()
    local folder = getPropFolder()
    if not folder then return {} end
    local target = CONFIG.PROP_PREFIX .. OWNER_NAME
    local found = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name == target then table.insert(found, obj) end
    end
    table.sort(found, function(a,b) return a:GetDebugId() < b:GetDebugId() end)
    while #found > CONFIG.MAX_PROPS do table.remove(found) end
    for _, p in ipairs(found) do rememberProp(p) end
    return found
end

local function invokeProp(prop, cf)
    if not prop or not prop.Parent then return end
    local r = prop:FindFirstChild("SetCurrentCFrame")
    if r and r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        pcall(function() r:InvokeServer(cf) end)
    elseif prop:IsA("BasePart") then
        prop.CFrame = cf
    end
end

local function pushColor(prop, color)
    if not prop or not prop.Parent then return end
    local r = prop:FindFirstChild("ChangePropColor")
    if r and r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        local ok = pcall(function() r:InvokeServer(color) end)

local function getHiddenCF(root)

local function getIdleOrbit(i, N, root)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- EASING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function easeOutCubic(t) return 1-(1-t)^3 end
local function easeInOutCubic(t)
    if t<0.5 then return 4*t*t*t end
    return 1-((-2*t+2)^3)/2
end
local function easeOutQuint(t) return 1-(1-t)^5 end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- TWEEN ALL PROPS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function tweenPropsTo(targetFn, duration, easeFn)
    easeFn = easeFn or easeOutCubic
    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return end
    local N = #state.props; if N == 0 then return end
    local startCFs = table.create(N)
    for i = 1, N do
        startCFs[i] = state.currentCFrames[i] or getHiddenCF(root)
    end
    local t0 = os.clock()
    while true do
        local a = duration <= 0 and 1 or math.clamp((os.clock()-t0)/duration, 0, 1)
        local e = easeFn(a)
        for i = 1, N do
            local prop = state.props[i]
            if prop and prop.Parent then
                local target = targetFn(i, a, e, root)
                if target then
                    local cf = startCFs[i]:Lerp(target, e)
                    state.currentCFrames[i] = cf
                    task.spawn(invokeProp, prop, cf)
                end
            end
        end
        if a >= 1 then break end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- LASER  (fix: pakai -Z = forward)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function doLaser()
    local N = #state.props; if N == 0 then return end

    -- SUMMON: cluster kecil di depan
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
        local ang = u*math.pi*2
        local r = (1-u*0.6)*1.4
        local x = math.cos(ang)*r
        local y = 1.8 + math.sin(ang)*0.4 + u*0.6
        local z = -2.5 - u*0.4  -- FORWARD
        return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, z)
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
    end, 0.30, easeOutQuint)

    -- EXTEND: beam ke DEPAN
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
        local z = -(3 + u*CONFIG.LASER_RANGE)   -- FORWARD (-Z)
        return root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, CONFIG.LASER_HEIGHT, z)
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
    end, 0.28, easeOutCubic)

    -- HOLD + wobble
    local tEnd = os.clock() + 0.65
    while os.clock() < tEnd do
        local root = getRoot()
        if root then
            for i = 1, N do
                local prop = state.props[i]
                if prop and prop.Parent then
                    local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
                    local z = -(3 + u*CONFIG.LASER_RANGE)
                    local wob = math.sin(os.clock()*34 + i)*0.16*u
                    local cf = root.CFrame
                        * CFrame.new(wob, CONFIG.LASER_HEIGHT, z)
                        * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
                    state.currentCFrames[i] = cf
                    task.spawn(invokeProp, prop, cf)
                end
            end
        end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- SWING  (fix: ada TRAIL di belakang blade)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function doSwing()
    local N = #state.props; if N == 0 then return end
    local A0, A1 = math.rad(-105), math.rad(105)

    -- SUMMON di sisi kanan (posisi awal)
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
        local ang = A0 - u*math.rad(20)
        local r = CONFIG.SWING_RADIUS + u*0.6
        return root.CFrame
            * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
            * CFrame.new(0, 2.4 + u*0.7, -r)
    end, 0.24, easeOutCubic)

    -- WINDUP pull lebih ke belakang kanan
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
        local ang = A0 - u*math.rad(28)
        local r = CONFIG.SWING_RADIUS + u*0.6
        return root.CFrame
            * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
            * CFrame.new(0, 2.1 + u*0.7, -r)
    end, 0.22, easeInOutCubic)

    task.wait(0.05)

    -- SWEEP dengan TRAIL (lag grow dengan progress)
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local u = (i-1)/math.max(N-1,1)
        local sweep = A0 + (A1 - A0) * e
        -- trailing: makin tinggi u makin ketinggalan
        local lag = u * math.rad(45) * e
        local ang = sweep - lag

        local r = CONFIG.SWING_RADIUS + (1-u)*1.8
        local y = 2.4 + math.sin(e*math.pi)*1.2 + u*0.6
        local tilt = math.rad(60) + e*math.rad(30)

        return root.CFrame
            * CFrame.Angles(0, ang, 0)
            * CFrame.new(0, y, -r)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), tilt)
    end, 0.32, easeOutQuint)

    task.wait(0.10)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- GRAB  (fix: bentuk TANGAN TERBUKA → MENUTUP)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function findGrabTarget()
    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return nil end
    local myPos, look = root.Position, root.CFrame.LookVector
    local best, bestScore = nil, -1
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local diff = hrp.Position - myPos
                local dist = diff.Magnitude
                if dist > 1 and dist < CONFIG.GRAB_RANGE then
                    local dot = look:Dot(diff.Unit)
                    if dot > 0.5 then
                        local s = dot * (1 - dist/CONFIG.GRAB_RANGE)
                        if s > bestScore then bestScore = s; best = hrp end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- palm/fingers builder
local function handPoint(i, N, center, forward, radius)
    local up = Vector3.new(0,1,0)
    local right = forward:Cross(up)
    if right.Magnitude < 0.01 then right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
    right = right.Unit
    local trueUp = right:Cross(forward).Unit
    local ang = ((i-1)/N) * math.pi * 2
    local off = right*math.cos(ang)*radius + trueUp*math.sin(ang)*radius
    return center + off, forward
end

local function doGrab()
    local N = #state.props; if N == 0 then return end
    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return end
    local target = findGrabTarget()

    local function getTargetPos()
        if target and target.Parent then return target.Position end
        local r = getRoot()
        return r and (r.Position + r.CFrame.LookVector*15 + Vector3.new(0,1,0)) or root.Position
    end

    -- SUMMON hand terbuka di depan
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local fwd = root.CFrame.LookVector
        local c   = root.Position + fwd*2.5 + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
        local pos, d = handPoint(i, N, c, fwd, 2.0*e)
        return CFrame.new(pos, pos + d)
    end, 0.28, easeOutCubic)

    -- EXTEND hand terbuka ke target
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local fwd = root.CFrame.LookVector
        local tPos = getTargetPos()
        local c = (root.Position + fwd*3):Lerp(tPos, e) + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
        local pos, d = handPoint(i, N, c, fwd, 2.0)
        return CFrame.new(pos, pos + d)
    end, 0.38, easeOutQuint)

    -- CLOSE hand (fingers converge)
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local fwd = root.CFrame.LookVector
        local c   = getTargetPos() + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
        local radius = 2.0 * (1 - e*0.92)
        local pos, d = handPoint(i, N, c, fwd, radius)
        return CFrame.new(pos, pos + d)
    end, 0.22, easeOutCubic)

    -- HOLD grip
    task.wait(0.28)

    -- RETRACT balik ke player
    tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
        local fwd = root.CFrame.LookVector
        local tPos = getTargetPos()
        local c = tPos:Lerp(root.Position + fwd*2.5 + Vector3.new(0,2.2,0), e)
        local radius = 0.16 + e*1.4
        local pos, d = handPoint(i, N, c, fwd, radius)
        return CFrame.new(pos, pos + d)
    end, 0.32, easeInOutCubic)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- BLEACH  (BARU: muncul dari tanah bawah player sekitar,
--          naik → turun → retarget, 1 prop / orang)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function doBleach()
    local N = #state.props; if N == 0 then return end
    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return end

    -- kumpulin target player + self
    local myPos = root.Position
    local targets = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp and (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude < CONFIG.BLEACH_RANGE then
                table.insert(targets, hrp)
            end
        end
    end
    table.insert(targets, root)  -- self juga kena

    local function targetPos(idx)
        local t = targets[idx]
        if t and t.Parent then return t.Position end
        local r = getRoot()
        return r and r.Position or myPos
    end

    local waves = 3
    for w = 1, waves do
        -- RISE dari tanah
        tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
            local ti = ((i - 1 + w - 1) % #targets) + 1
            local tp = targetPos(ti)
            local y  = -4 + e * 7.5
            return CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, y, 0))
                * CFrame.Angles(0, os.clock()*3 + i*0.5, 0)
        end, 0.32, easeOutCubic)

        task.wait(0.03)

        -- SINK balik ke tanah
        tweenPropsTo(function(i, a, e, root)
            local ti = ((i - 1 + w - 1) % #targets) + 1
            local tp = targetPos(ti)
            local y  = 3.5 - e * 7.5
            return CFrame.new(tp + Vector3.new(0, y, 0))
                * CFrame.Angles(0, os.clock()*3 + i, 0)
        end, 0.22, easeInOutCubic)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function retractAll()
    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return end
    tweenPropsTo(function() return getHiddenCF(root) end, 0.42, easeInOutCubic)
end

local function canUse(name)
    if not state.enabled then return false end
    if state.currentAbility then return false end
    if os.clock() - state.lastUsed[name] < ABILITY_DEFS[name].cooldown then return false end
    return true
end

local function runAbility(name)
    if not canUse(name) then return end
    state.currentAbility = name
    state.abilityState[name] = "summon"
    state.lastUsed[name] = os.clock()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if name == "LASER" then doLaser()
            elseif name == "SWING" then doSwing()
            elseif name == "GRAB" then doGrab()
            elseif name == "BLEACH" then doBleach() end
        end)
        if not ok then warn("[MR.XENO] "..name.." err: "..tostring(err)) end
        state.abilityState[name] = "retract"
        retractAll()
        state.abilityState[name] = "idle"
        state.currentAbility = nil
        if not state.enabled then restoreColors() end
    end)
end

    state.tickAccum += dt
    if state.tickAccum < CONFIG.TICK_RATE then return end
    local step = state.tickAccum
    state.tickAccum = 0

    local root = getRoot(); if not root then return end

    state.colorPhase += step * CONFIG.CYCLE_SPEED
    local pal = currentPalette()
    local n = #pal
    local c = state.colorPhase % n
    local i1 = math.floor(c) + 1
    local i2 = (i1 % n) + 1
    local frac = c - math.floor(c)
    state.color = pal[i1]:Lerp(pal[i2], frac)

    if not state.currentAbility then
        local N = #state.props
        for i, prop in ipairs(state.props) do

local function scanNPCs()
    local list = {}
    local container = getNPCContainer()
    if not container then return list end
    local seen = {}
    local function tryAdd(char)
        if not char or seen[char] then return end
        seen[char] = true
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char.PrimaryPart
        if hum and head and root then
            table.insert(list, {
                Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                IsNPC=true, Label="NPC",
            })
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(d)) end
    for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(c)) end
    return list
end
local function scanPlayers()
    local list = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and head and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                        Player=plr, IsNPC=false, Label=plr.Name, Team=plr.Team,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end
local function scanAll()
    local list = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanNPCs()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    for _, t in ipairs(scanPlayers()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    return list
end

-- WALL CHECK
local function hasLineOfSight(fromPos, toPos, target)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local ignore = {}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(ignore, LP.Character) end
    if target and target.Character then table.insert(ignore, target.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local result = WS:Raycast(fromPos, toPos - fromPos, params)
    return result == nil
end

    end

                    local w = math.max(h * 0.55, 12)
                    local x = ts.X - w * 0.5
                    local y = ts.Y
                    local col
                    if t.IsNPC then
                        col = Config.ESP.NPCColor
                    elseif t.Player and LP.Team and t.Team
                    and t.Team == LP.Team then
                        col = Config.ESP.TeamColor
                    else

                    end

                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
                    d.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                    d.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    d.stroke.Color = col
                    d.name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
                    d.name.Text = t.IsNPC and "NPC" or t.Label
                    d.name.TextColor3 = col
                    d.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y - 18)
                    d.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14)
                    d.name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    d.dist.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
                    d.dist.Text = string.format("[%dm]", math.floor(dist))
                    d.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y + h + 2)
                    d.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12)
                    d.dist.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    if Config.ESP.Health and t.Humanoid then
                        local hp = math.clamp(
                            t.Humanoid.Health / math.max(t.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                            0, 1)
                        d.hpBg.Visible = true
                        d.hpBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y)
                        d.hpBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
                        d.hpFill.Visible = true

                        d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h * hp)
                        d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.floor(255*(1-hp)), math.floor(255*hp), 0)
                    else
                        d.hpBg.Visible = false
                        d.hpFill.Visible = false
                    end
                else hideESP(d) end
            else hideESP(d) end
        end
    end
    for char, d in pairs(espDrawings) do
        if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then
            hideESP(d)
            if not char.Parent then
                for _, part in pairs(d) do
                    if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                espDrawings[char] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- AIMBOT
local function aimCameraAt(target, part, smoothness)
    if not target or not part then return false end
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local goal = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, smoothness)
    return true
end

local function findBestTarget()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    local center = viewportCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then return nil end
    local camPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if t.IsNPC or not (LP.Team and t.Team and t.Team == LP.Team) then
            local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and t.Head or t.Root
            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                if d <= Config.Aimbot.FOV and d < bestD then
                    -- Wall check: cast a ray from the camera to the target part
                    local pass = true
                    if Config.Aimbot.WallCheck then
                        pass = hasLineOfSight(camPos, part.Position, t)
                    end
                    if pass then
                        bestD = d; best = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function updateAimbot()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return end
    if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return end
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    local target = findBestTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and target.Head or target.Root
    aimCameraAt(target, part, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness)
end

local FlightBV = nil
local function flightStart()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not hrp or not hum then return end

        if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy() end
        FlightBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

        FlightBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero

    end
end
local function flightStop()
    if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy(); FlightBV = nil end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

local function updateMisc()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum then return end

    -- WalkSpeed
    if Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled then
        hum.WalkSpeed = Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value
    end

    -- JumpPower
    if Config.Misc.JumpPower.Enabled then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = Config.Misc.JumpPower.Value
    end

    -- NoClip
    if Config.Misc.NoClip then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Flight
    if Config.Misc.Flight.Enabled then
        if not FlightBV or not hrp then
            flightStart()
        end
        if FlightBV and hrp then
            local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local move = Vector3.zero
                local speed = Config.Misc.Flight.Speed
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move = move - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * speed end
                FlightBV.Velocity = move
            end
        end
    else
        if FlightBV then flightStop() end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local GunESP = true
local PickupGun = false
local PlayerESP = false

local GunColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local PlayerColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "ESP_Gui"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Name = "Main"
Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 160)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -80)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Parent = Gui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Hack Menu"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

        Dragging = true
        DragStart = Input.Position
        StartPosition = Frame.Position

        Input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Dragging = false
            end

        end)

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

    if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

        local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            StartPosition.X.Scale,
            StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
            StartPosition.Y.Scale,
            StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
        )

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATOR
--==================================================

local function CreateButton(Text, Position)

    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
    Button.Position = Position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Button.TextSize = 14
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.AutoButtonColor = true
    Button.Parent = Frame

    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button

    return Button

end

--==================================================
-- BUTTONS
--==================================================

local GunButton = CreateButton(
    "Gun ESP: ON",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
)

local PickupButton = CreateButton(
    "Pickup Gun: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 77)
)

local PlayerButton = CreateButton(
    "Player ESP: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 119)
)

--==================================================
-- GUN DRAWING
--==================================================

local GunLine = Drawing.new("Line")

GunLine.Visible = false
GunLine.Color = GunColor
GunLine.Thickness = 2
GunLine.Transparency = 1

local GunText = Drawing.new("Text")

GunText.Visible = false
GunText.Text = "GunDrop"
GunText.Color = GunColor
GunText.Size = 16
GunText.Center = true
GunText.Outline = true
GunText.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local GunHighlight
local LastGun

--==================================================
-- FIND GUN
--==================================================

local function GetGun()

    for _, Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object.Name == "GunDrop" then
            return Object
        end

    end

    return nil

end

--==================================================
-- GUN HIGHLIGHT
--==================================================

local function SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight:Destroy()
        GunHighlight = nil
    end

    if Gun then

        GunHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

        GunHighlight.Name = "GunDropHighlight"
        GunHighlight.Adornee = Gun

        GunHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
        GunHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5

        GunHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        GunHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

        GunHighlight.DepthMode =
            Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

        GunHighlight.Enabled = GunESP
        GunHighlight.Parent = Gun

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local PlayerHighlights = {}
local PlayerTexts = {}

local function RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    if PlayerHighlights[Player] then
        PlayerHighlights[Player]:Destroy()
        PlayerHighlights[Player] = nil
    end

    if PlayerTexts[Player] then
        PlayerTexts[Player]:Remove()
        PlayerTexts[Player] = nil
    end

end

local function AddPlayerESP(Player)

    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    local Character = Player.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
    Highlight.Adornee = Character
    Highlight.FillColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.OutlineColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    Highlight.DepthMode =
        Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    Highlight.Parent = Character

    PlayerHighlights[Player] = Highlight

    local Text = Drawing.new("Text")

    Text.Text = Player.DisplayName
    Text.Color = PlayerColor
    Text.Size = 16
    Text.Center = true
    Text.Outline = true
    Text.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Text.Visible = false

    PlayerTexts[Player] = Text

end

local function RefreshPlayerESP()

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then

            if PlayerESP then
                AddPlayerESP(Player)
            else
                RemovePlayerESP(Player)
            end

        end

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER JOIN
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)

    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.5)

        if PlayerESP then
            AddPlayerESP(Player)
        end

    end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

GunButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    GunESP = not GunESP

    GunButton.Text =
        "Gun ESP: " .. (GunESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    if not GunESP then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

    else

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = true
        end

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PICKUP GUN BUTTON
--==================================================

PickupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PickupGun = not PickupGun

    PickupButton.Text =
        "Pickup Gun: " .. (PickupGun and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--==================================================
-- CONTINUOUS GUN BRING TO TORSO
--==================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not PickupGun then
        return
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    -- R15 = UpperTorso
    -- R6  = Torso
    -- Fallback = HumanoidRootPart
    local Torso =
        Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not Torso then
        return
    end

    local Gun = GetGun()

    if not Gun then
        return
    end

    -- Move ONLY GunDrop to the torso
    local TargetCFrame = Torso.CFrame

    if Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Gun:PivotTo(TargetCFrame)

    elseif Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Gun.CFrame = TargetCFrame

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

PlayerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PlayerESP = not PlayerESP

    PlayerButton.Text =
        "Player ESP: " .. (PlayerESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    RefreshPlayerESP()

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    local Gun = GetGun()

    -- Detect new GunDrop
    if Gun ~= LastGun then

        LastGun = Gun

        if Gun then

            SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

        elseif GunHighlight then

            GunHighlight:Destroy()
            GunHighlight = nil

        end

    end

    if not GunESP or not Gun then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return

    end

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight.Enabled = true
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Position

    if Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Position = Gun.Position

    elseif Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Position = Gun:GetPivot().Position

    end

    if not Position then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        return

    end

    local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
        Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Position)

    if OnScreen then

        local Mouse =
            UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

        GunLine.Visible = true
        GunText.Visible = true

        GunLine.From = Vector2.new(
            Mouse.X,
            Mouse.Y
        )

        GunLine.To = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y
        )

        GunText.Position = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y - 25
        )

    else

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    if not PlayerESP then
        return
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    for Player, Text in pairs(PlayerTexts) do

        local Character = Player.Character

        if Character then

            local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if Head then

                local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
                    Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                        Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                    )

                if OnScreen then

                    Text.Position = Vector2.new(
                        ScreenPosition.X,
                        ScreenPosition.Y
                    )

                    Text.Visible = true

                else

                    Text.Visible = false

                end

            else

                Text.Visible = false

            end

        else

            Text.Visible = false

        end

    end

end)

local UserInputService = game.GetService(game, 'UserInputService')
local Players = game.GetService(game, 'Players')

-- > Variables
local LocalPlayer, Camera = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

-- > Functions
function GetClosestTarget(...)
    local Args = {...}
    if not Args then return nil end
    --
    local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
    for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
        if LocalPlayer == Value then continue end
        --
        local Character = Value.Character
        if not Character then continue end
        --
        local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
        if not Head then return Target end
        --
        local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
        --
        local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Args[1], Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
        if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
        --
        local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
        if not OnScreen then continue end
        --
        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
        if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
    end
    --
    return Target
end

-- > Connections
for Index, Value in next, getgc() do
    if typeof(Value) ~= 'function' then continue end
    --
    if debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessProjectiles' or debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessShot' then
		local Original; Original = hookfunction(Value, function(...)
            local Args = {...}
            --
            local Target = GetClosestTarget(Args[1]:GetBase().Tip.WorldPosition)
            if not Target then return Original(table.unpack(Args)) end
            --
            Args[3] = Target.Position
            return Original(table.unpack(Args))
        end)
    end
end

local categories = {}
local activeCategoryName = nil

local function addCategory(name)
    local catButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    catButton.Name = name .. "Btn"
    catButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    catButton.Text = name
    catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    catButton.TextSize = 11
    catButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    catButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    catButton.Parent = categoryScroll
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    btnCorner.Parent = catButton
    
    local togglesScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    togglesScroll.Name = name .. "ToggleScroll"
    togglesScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
    togglesScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
    togglesScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    togglesScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    togglesScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    togglesScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    togglesScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    togglesScroll.Visible = false
    togglesScroll.Parent = toggleArea
    
    local tLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    tLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    tLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    tLayout.Parent = togglesScroll
    
    local tPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    tPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
    tPad.Parent = togglesScroll
    
    categories[name] = {
        Button = catButton,
        Container = togglesScroll
    }
    
    catButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for catName, data in pairs(categories) do
            data.Container.Visible = false
            data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
            data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        end
        togglesScroll.Visible = true
        catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        activeCategoryName = name
    end)
    
    if not activeCategoryName then
        togglesScroll.Visible = true
        catButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
        catButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        activeCategoryName = name
    end
    
    return togglesScroll
end

local function createToggle(catScroll, name, labelText, callback)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = name .. "Container"
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Parent = catScroll
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelText
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container
    
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name .. "Button"
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 18)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -9)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    button.Text = ""
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Parent = container
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    btnCorner.Parent = button
    
    local indicator = Instance.new("Frame")
    indicator.Name = "Indicator"
    indicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    indicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)
    indicator.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    indicator.Parent = button
    
    local indCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    indCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    indCorner.Parent = indicator
    
    local state = false
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        if state then
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
            indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        else
            button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
            indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        end
        if callback then task.spawn(callback, state) end
    end)
    
    return {
        GetState = function() return state end,
        SetState = function(val)
            if state ~= val then
                state = val
                if state then
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
                    indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
                else
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
                    indicator:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
                end
                if callback then task.spawn(callback, state) end
            end
        end
    }
end

local function createSlider(catScroll, name, labelText, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = name .. "SliderContainer"
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.Parent = catScroll

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelText .. ": " .. tostring(defaultVal)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    label.TextSize = 11
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = container

    local foldBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    foldBtn.Name = "FoldButton"
    foldBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    foldBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    foldBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 0)
    foldBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    foldBtn.Text = "-"
    foldBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    foldBtn.TextSize = 13
    foldBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    foldBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    foldBtn.Parent = container

    local foldCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    foldCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    foldCorner.Parent = foldBtn
    
    local sliderBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBar.Name = "SliderBar"
    sliderBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 6)
    sliderBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 26)
    sliderBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    sliderBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBar.Parent = container
    
    local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    barCorner.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local fillBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    fillBar.Name = "FillBar"
    fillBar.Size = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0)
    fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)
    fillBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fillBar.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fillCorner.Parent = fillBar
    
    local thumb = Instance.new("TextButton")
    thumb.Name = "Thumb"
    thumb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
    thumb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    thumb.Position = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 0.5, 0)
    thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    thumb.Text = ""
    thumb.AutoButtonColor = false
    thumb.Parent = sliderBar
    
    local thumbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    thumbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    thumbCorner.Parent = thumb
    
    local isFolded = false
    foldBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isFolded = not isFolded
        if isFolded then
            foldBtn.Text = "+"
            sliderBar.Visible = false
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
        else
            foldBtn.Text = "-"
            sliderBar.Visible = true
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
        end
    end)

    local currentValue = defaultVal
    local sliding = false
    
    local function updateValue(inputPos)
        local barPos = sliderBar.AbsolutePosition.X
        local barSize = sliderBar.AbsoluteSize.X
        local relativeX = math.clamp(inputPos - barPos, 0, barSize)
        local percentage = relativeX / barSize
        currentValue = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * percentage)
        
        fillBar.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
        thumb.Position = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 0.5, 0)
        label.Text = labelText .. ": " .. tostring(currentValue)
    end
    
    thumb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
        end
    end)
    
    sliderBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    
    return {
        GetValue = function() return currentValue end
    }
end

local loopTpwalkToggle
local loopSpeedSlider
local selfFreezeToggle
local desyncToggle
local desyncSpeedSlider

local function startLoopTPWalk()
    if loopTpwalking then return end
    loopTpwalking = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while loopTpwalking and scriptRunning do
            local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
            if char and hum and hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0 then
                local speed = loopSpeedSlider.GetValue()
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        char:TranslateBy(hum.MoveDirection * speed * delta * 10)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function startDesyncTPWalk()
    if desyncTpwalking then return end
    desyncTpwalking = true
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while desyncTpwalking and scriptRunning and char and hum and hum.Parent do
            local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local speed = desyncSpeedSlider.GetValue()
            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    char:TranslateBy(hum.MoveDirection * speed * delta * 10)
                end)
            end
            if not player.Character or player.Character ~= char then
                desyncTpwalking = false
                if desyncToggle then desyncToggle.SetState(false) end
            end
        end
    end)
end

loopTpwalkToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "LoopTPWalk", "Loop TPWalk Speed", function(state)
    if state then
        startLoopTPWalk()
    else
        stopLoopTPWalk()
    end
end)

loopSpeedSlider = createSlider(playerScroll, "LoopSpeedSlider", "Loop TPWalk Speed", 1, 25, 4)

selfFreezeToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "SelfFreeze", "Self Freeze")

desyncToggle = createToggle(playerScroll, "Desync", "Server-sided Desync", function(state)
    if state then
        startDesyncTPWalk()
    else
        stopDesyncTPWalk()
    end
end)

desyncSpeedSlider = createSlider(playerScroll, "DesyncSpeedSlider", "Desync Speed", 1, 25, 4)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopDesyncTPWalk()
    if desyncToggle then desyncToggle.SetState(false) end
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, 
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
            startPos.Y.Scale, 
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while scriptRunning do
        local delta = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if (selfFreezeToggle.GetState() or desyncToggle.GetState()) and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            rootPart.Anchored = true
            if selfFreezeToggle.GetState() then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
            end
        else
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.Anchored = false
            end
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            end
        end
        
        task.wait(0.1)
        
        if mainToggle.GetState() then
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local val = currentAttackValue
                
                if disabler1000.GetState() and val >= 1000 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler500.GetState() and val >= 500 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler250.GetState() and val >= 250 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler100.GetState() and val >= 100 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                elseif disabler5.GetState() and val >= 5 then
                    mainToggle.SetState(false)
                end
                
                if mainToggle.GetState() then
                    pcall(function()
                        generateAttackEvent:FireServer("Random", nil, nil)
                    end)
                end
            else
                currentAttackValue = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Salchiblox Speed v7 (Clean, Bug-Free, Custom Colors, Discord Link & Locked UI)
if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxGui") then
    game.CoreGui.SalchibloxGui:Destroy()
end
if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxScreenParticles") then
    game.CoreGui.SalchibloxScreenParticles:Destroy()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Config File Setup
local CONFIG_FILE = "SalchibloxSpeedConfig.json"
local baseSpeed, speedMultiplier = 16, 1
local baseJump, jumpMultiplier = 50, 1
local gravityVal = 196

local function loadExistingConfig()
    if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
        local success, data = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
        end)
        if success and data then
            baseSpeed = data.baseSpeed or 16
            speedMultiplier = data.speedMultiplier or 1
            baseJump = data.baseJump or 50
            jumpMultiplier = data.jumpMultiplier or 1
            gravityVal = data.gravityVal or 196
        end
    end
end
loadExistingConfig()

-- Anti-Kick & Basic Anti-Cheat Bypass Hook
pcall(function()
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if method == "Kick" or method == "kick" then
            if self == player then
                warn("[Salchiblox] Blocked an attempt to kick you!")
                return
            end
        end
        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
end)

local function createSlider(parent, name, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, yPos, callback)
    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos)
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    Label.Text = name .. ": " .. defaultVal
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 13
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local SliderBG = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    SliderBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 48)
    SliderBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderBG.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, yPos + 20)
    SliderBG.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 8)
    Instance.new("UICorner", SliderBG).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local SliderFill = Instance.new("Frame", SliderBG)
    SliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 255)
    SliderFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new((defaultVal - minVal)/(maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0)
    Instance.new("UICorner", SliderFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateInput(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - SliderBG.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderBG.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * pos)
        SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        Label.Text = name .. ": " .. value
        callback(value)
    end

    SliderBG.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateInput(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateInput(input)
        end
    end)
end

-- Execution Loop (Speed, Jump, Bypass protection)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local hum = char.Humanoid
        
        hum.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed * speedMultiplier
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = baseJump * jumpMultiplier
        
        if spinbotActive and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(25), 0)
        end
    end
    
    if noclipEnabled and char then
        for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    if auraActive and char then
        for _, p in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                p.Color = activeThemeColor
                p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end
    end
end)
